# Commissioner API and Build Paths

<!-- Generated by Bee (Sol 6.1) C7 synthesis 2026-10-13 from the read-only MFL commissioner map; gated by Claude. League-private values (salaries, owners) are excluded from this public repo; they stay in the Beelink run dir. -->

## 3. API table
Reads include result-data exports and explicitly qualified related reads. Matching writes must change this control’s data; related participant actions do not become settings writers. “Website only” means neither a matching read nor a matching write was documented, not proof that an undocumented API cannot exist. A result-data API read does not make its settings editable. Guards and C6 skips are not evidence of an absent API.

All imports mutate data and require documented authenticated access; commissioner-required imports need the commissioner cookie, not an API key. `live_draft` is a separate miscellaneous command, **not an import TYPE**. Its skip/undo mapping is restricted to the running draft and is not full equivalence to the never-open web pages.
